resources.string: Public design. Private keys.\nNo false claims.\nIndependent verification.
SECURITY NOTICE: ALPHA PROTOTYPE — NO INDEPENDENT AUDIT
Do not use for irreplaceable data or live system partitions.
Raw disk encryption and TPM-enforced brute-force limits: NOT IMPLEMENTED.
OFFLINE · TEST FILES ONLY · NOT CERTIFIED
NO SECURITY CLAIM WITHOUT IMPLEMENTATION AND AUDIT
Planned: independent USB/SSD/HDD volume encryption. Hardware anti-brute-force protection has NOT been implemented. No disks are modified.
Planned: system-volume protection with TPM 2.0, Secure Boot and recovery. No pre-boot encryption is implemented. Do not test this on a system disk.
Planned: isolated password vault and reauthorization. Existing passwords are not accessed or managed.
Planned: Android OS encryption and Keystore integration. This application does not encrypt the phone.
You may use a PIN (even one digit) or a password. An empty password is not allowed.
Two factors: password/PIN plus separate keyfile. This is NOT hardware-enforced attempt limiting. Keep the keyfile separately.
OFFLINE BRUTE-FORCE RISK: a short PIN alone can be guessed from a copied ciphertext. Use a separate secret.
A short password without an independent secret is still vulnerable to offline guessing.
A long, random, unique password improves protection. This prototype has NO hardware attempt limit.
THE HEADER IS PUBLIC AND UNVERIFIED until successful decryption.
